key_finding: ALL Excellent titles come from peer_video_signal. Zero Excellent titles from dna_original_bets. Narrative templates cannot be reliably generated from DNA alone — they require surfacing real peer content with strong narrative hooks.

generation_strategy.narrative_filter: surface peer titles with ASSUMPTION_REVERSAL, FORCED_CONFLICT, CONFLICT_EXPOSE, MEMORY_OBJECT patterns
generation_strategy.dna_strategy: Focus DNA bets on: mistake + instructional + challenge + comparison templates
generation_strategy.peer_upgrade: Rank peer signals with narrative hook patterns above non-narrative peer signals

structures.name: Hidden Mechanism
structures.description: Reveals the actual cause or mechanism behind a familiar phenomenon. "What really happened" structure.
structures.hook_trigger: The real reason / What really / The truth behind
structures.generation_requires: peer signal OR DNA bet with specific cause + familiar effect

peer_signal_curation_rules: Include peer titles with word count >= 8 (narrative signals are long)
Boost peer titles matching ASSUMPTION_REVERSAL, FORCED_CONFLICT, CONFLICT_EXPOSE patterns
Include peer titles with named entities + claim verbs (proves, shows, reveals)
Exclude peer titles matching spam patterns (episode numbers, LIVE suffix, collab format)
Peer titles with named specific subject (The Tiger, Trump, Black Holes) rank above generic
